description:
Example Manufacturing Ltd (fictional) - personnel:
20 employees: 12 machinists/welders (CNC, robotic welding, demanding steel grades, average experience over 10 years); four assembly workers (finishing, testing, surface treatment coordination); two administration/sales staff (customers, invoicing, projects); one designer (CAD and production support); one CEO (founder, strategy, customers). Flat hierarchy, employee ownership and low turnover. Benefits include training, exercise support and flexible working hours.
